title: The Backman–Baker–Yuen consistency conjecture for regular matroids
statement: Let $M=(E,\mathcal B,\chi)$ be an oriented regular matroid, let $(\sigma,\sigma^*)$ be a pair of acyclic circuit and cocircuit signatures, and let $\alpha_{(M,\sigma,\sigma^*)}$ be the Backman–Baker–Yuen matroidal sandpile torsor action on the bases $\mathcal B$. The action is called **consistent** if it satisfies the stated contraction and deletion compatibilities for every regular matroid, every such signature pair, every basis $B\in\mathcal B$, and every $f\in E$. **Backman–Baker–Yuen consistency conjecture.** The Backman–Baker–Yuen matroidal sandpile torsor algorithm is consistent. The paper notes that the proposed matroidal consistency definition may need adjustment, so this conjecture remains open in the stated framework.
source_name: Ankan Ganguly and Alex McDonough, “Rotor-Routing Induces the Only Consistent Sandpile Torsor Structure on Plane Graphs”, arXiv:2203.15079 (2023).
